## Previs

<!-- For UI/UX tickets, provide a visual prototype that looks as close as possible to the current app. -->

- [ ] This ticket involves UI/UX.

If checked, generate a self-contained HTML previs that visually matches the current app:

1. Create a single `.html` file with inlined CSS and (optionally) inlined images.
2. Upload it as a secret or public [GitHub Gist](https://gist.github.com).
3. Embed it in the issue using the Hyouji HTML renderer:
   `https://www.hyouji.moe/?gist=https://gist.github.com/<user>/<gist-id>`

   Example: https://www.hyouji.moe/?gist=https://gist.github.com/Moistbobo/2c8c0671ba55cc25bab183c3b6bcc3c8

**Previs URL:**
